name: servicemap
description: Generate an internal service map page or desktop app for a software project.

scripts.test: node bin/servicemap.mjs generate --root demo-project --allow-emails founder@example.com,ops@example.com --dry-run && node bin/servicemap.mjs --root no-website-demo --dry-run && node bin/servicemap.mjs --dry-run && HOME="$(mktemp -d)" node bin/servicemap.mjs && node bin/servicemap.mjs install-skill --agent all --dry-run && node bin/servicemap.mjs install-skill --targets universal,claude,grok --dry-run && node bin/servicemap.mjs install-skill --targets codex,chatgpt,gpt-6-astra --dry-run && node bin/servicemap.mjs skills install --agent claude --dry-run
